# TPC-DI A3

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcdi
```

> [TPC-DI](../../tpc-di.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DI queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT s.Symbol, s.Name, COUNT(t.TradeID) AS trade_count, SUM(t.Quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(t.TradePrice) AS avg_price, MIN(t.TradePrice) AS min_price, MAX(t.TradePrice) AS max_price, SUM(t.Quantity * t.TradePrice) AS total_value FROM DimSecurity AS s JOIN FactTrade AS t ON s.SK_SecurityID = t.SK_SecurityID WHERE s.IsCurrent IS TRUE AND t.Status = 'Completed' GROUP BY s.Symbol, s.Name HAVING COUNT(t.TradeID) > 100 ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 50
```
